title: Chapter 161 Cavalry Barracks
content:
Chapter 161 Cavalry Barracks

Wang Shuo was wondering, his horses all used horse cards, so there was no need for stables.

He shook his head, confused. Could it be that horse cards can no longer be used in the future?

This possibility is not impossible. If the system is upgraded again and reaches version 3.0, it's really hard to say.

It seems that everything requires some preparation.

Directly east of the training ground, there is a large building with a slightly primitive style, all made of green bricks and green tiles.

Wang Shuo quickly stepped forward, checked them one by one, and called him a good guy.

Barracks, canteen, toilets, combat command center...

It really has everything.

It is like an independent living and training area.

Wang Shuo regretted that he had built the military camp too close to the residential area of the village.

It seems that in the future, after it is upgraded to a small town, it will have to be moved further away. After all, the life training facilities inside are very complete.

Wang Shuo walked into the combat command center. In front of him was a huge sand table. What was even more amazing was that the map directly in front of him was actually a dynamic map, exactly the same as the map in Wang Shuo's "Survivor's Manual".

Wang Shuo was amazed to see this.

In the corner, there is something similar to a resource exchange stone.

After clicking it, a redemption interface also popped up.

As expected, there is a cavalry job transfer scroll inside.

Wang Shuo felt happy.

The number of cavalry job transfer scrolls inside can be purchased up to 100 per day.

Each requires 100 energy crystals.

Wang Shuo did not hesitate and bought 100 sheets.

After bringing all the newly recruited tool men to the cavalry battalion, Wang Shuo arranged for them to be transferred directly.

As a result, the number of Golden Fire Cavalry suddenly reached 70, and the scale was beginning to take shape.

Looking at the neatly arranged war horses and the majestic cavalry, Wang Shuo's blood suddenly surged.

"Ayub, take your troops and drill them again. Let me see." Wang Shuo rode a war horse and walked from one side of the cavalry troops to the other side in order to review them.

"Yes! Lord Lord!"

"The whole army obeyed the order and marched rapidly along the racecourse!"

The sound of horse hooves continued, causing a cloud of dust to fly.

Groups of war horses are galloping, majestic and impressive, but the number is still a little small. If the scale is large enough, they must be invincible!

At this moment, Wang Shuo discovered that the cavalry actually had ranks.

The current cavalry units are all first-level cavalry.

The rank of the cavalry is related to the level of the barracks. Only the second-level cavalry battalion can advance the cavalry to the second level.

Wang Shuo still doesn't understand the specific situation, so he can only wait until later.

At this time, Wang Shuo thought that cavalry alone was not enough. He also had many militiamen and could not let them feel cold.

So I quickly came to the resource exchange office (where the resource exchange stone is).

After clicking on it, he found that the basic barracks still existed, and Wang Shuo quickly exchanged it for another one.

The cavalry barracks was placed near the south city gate. Wang Shuo walked to the north city gate and placed him there.

Choose to upgrade to an Infantry Barracks.

Another dazzling change.

The infantry barracks is half the size of the cavalry barracks, but it has more facilities inside.

After Wang Shuo checked them one by one, he understood.

The infantry barracks were temporarily handed over to Baili Liang to select those with outstanding qualifications and willingness to join the military to participate in training.

One of the red-line indicators for joining is loyalty. Wang Shuo will not let a citizen who has not reached 95 points of loyalty join the barracks.

Just then, Guli Ji returned to the village.

After hearing her report, Wang Shuo planned to summon the core personnel of the territory to hold a meeting about Qingmuzhai.
